Rooibos.d: Aspalathus linearis grown in the Cederberg; in 2014 the first South African geographical indication for a product other than wine or spirits, guarded by the South African Rooibos Council.

v.d: Theron's 'Rooibos' mark registered 1994, both sides dropped claims in 2005 making the word generic in the US

Rooibos.dt: area: Cederberg, about 200 km north of Cape Town · protected terms: rooibos, red bush, rooibos tea

Vanuatu noble kava.d: Common two-day variety reserved for ceremonies, not exportable

Fiji waka.d: Made only from lateral roots, highest kavalactone content; drunk from a coconut-shell bilo

notes: Honeybush also has GI protection under the same South African framework (WIPO page). Left out: Rosamonte, Cruz de Malta, La Merced, Canarias, Baldo (retail pages only), INYM geographical indication (PDF returned 403), lawena.
